messages:
Maria: folks, putting together HelixCare SLA packet for renewal. Need: 30d rolling uptime, p95 per route & per-model, incident summaries, and sample credit calc. Draft due EOD tomorrow.

Kevin: got it. Do they want 90/180d history or just snapshot?

Maria: 30d + a 90d highlight period.

Raj: I'll export route-level p95s and per-model timings. They use embeddings + chat; we should show quantized vs fp16. Also will include client-to-edge and server-side token times.

Nadia: ops-bot: perf export initiated for thread 4132107777
Nadia: I'll push CSVs to /exports/helixcare/sla/4132107777/

Raj: quick figures to include:
```
Uptime (30d rolling): 99.93%
P95 chat-invoke (client->edge): 360ms
P95 chat-server-tokens: 280ms
P95 embeddings: 120ms
Model variants: redwood-rlhf-v2-8b-quant, redwood-rlhf-v2-8b-fp16
```

Maria: add a 3-bullet incident narrative for the Nov 3 event (root cause + fix + long-term mitigation). Procurement prefers plain language.

Raj: draft incident blurb:
- Outage window: 2024-11-03 02:15–03:45 UTC
- Cause: autoscaler race condition that left GPU pools underprovisioned
- Fix: hotpatch + manual pool resize; mitigation: autoscaler patch + alerting rule on pool headroom

Kevin: I'll offer a 60-min enablement session for their infra team during renewal week. Maria, want me to propose times?

Maria: yes please. Also include a short enablement checklist in the packet: on-call contacts, synthetic check commands, token accounting, routing fallbacks, and recommended test prompts.

Raj: synthetic test snippet:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
```

Nadia: sample credit calc for doc:
```
SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime
Month hrs: 720
Allowed downtime: 0.72h
Observed downtime: 2.5h
Excess: 1.78h
Credit = (1.78 / 720) * monthly_fee
```

Maria: include a worked example with a $12,000 monthly fee.

Kevin: scheduled tentative walkthrough Thu 10am PT with HelixCare lead :calendar:

Maria: thanks. I'll assemble the packet (charts + CSV + onepage incident list + credit examples + enablement checklist) and post draft here by 10am tomorrow. Nadia, confirm the export path when done.

Nadia: confirmed: /exports/helixcare/sla/4132107777/ will contain: uptime_timeseries.csv, p95_by_route.csv, incident-2024-11-03.md, synthetic_playbook.md

Maria: perfect, tagging @Kevin @Raj to review before I send to procurement. :thumbsup:
